cards.name: Chrono-Saur Tricera

effects.printed_clause: This card can attack while in face-up Defense Position. If it does, apply its DEF for damage calculation.
effects.lua_implementation: A single EFFECT_DEFENSE_ATTACK with value 1 implements both defense-position attack permission and DEF use.

official_references.official_effect_text:
1 "Superheavy Samurai" Tuner + 2+ non-Tuner "Superheavy Samurai" monsters
This card can attack while in face-up Defense Position. If it does, apply its DEF for damage calculation. [b]Once[/b] [b]per turn[/b]: [b]You can[/b] [b]discard[/b] up to 2 cards, [b]then[/b] [b]target[/b] that many cards your opponent controls; [b]destroy[/b] them. [b]Once[/b] [b]per turn[/b]: [b]You can[/b] [b]banish[/b] all Spells [b]and[/b] Traps from the GYs, [b]and if you do[/b], inflict 200 damage to your opponent for each card banished.

effects.printed_clause: If you Special Summoned a "Chrono-Saur" or Dinosaur monster this turn: You can Special Summon this card from your hand or GY in Defense Position.
effects.lua_implementation: A duel-global Summon-success tracker flags the Summon player for 0xdae7 or Dinosaur monsters through PHASE_END; a hand/GY Ignition Effect summons the handler face-up Defense under Necrovalley.

official_references.official_effect_text:
If this card is Special Summoned by the effect of "Parallel eXceed", its Level becomes 4 [b]and[/b] its original ATK/DEF become halved. [b]You can[/b] only use each of the following effects of "Parallel eXceed" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b].
● If you Link Summon: [b]You can[/b] Special Summon this card from your hand to your zone that Link Monster points to.
● If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: [b]You can[/b] Special Summon 1 "Parallel eXceed" from your Deck.

If you control "King's Sarcophagus", [b]you can[/b] Special Summon this card (from your GY). [b]You can[/b] only Special Summon "Duamutef, Blessing of Horus" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b] this way. Gains 1200 ATK/DEF for each "Horus" monster you control. If another card(s) you control leaves the field by an opponent's card effect, while this card is in your Monster Zone (except during the Damage Step): [b]You can[/b] draw cards equal to the number of monsters with different names in your Main Monster Zone. [b]You can[/b] only use this effect of "Duamutef, Blessing of Horus" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b].

effects.printed_clause: When your opponent activates a card effect that targets a Dinosaur monster you control, or when your opponent targets your Dinosaur monster for an attack (Quick effect): You can destroy this card, then negate that attack or effect.
effects.lua_implementation: e3 checks opponent, target property, chain-disablability and a face-up controlled Dinosaur target; at resolution it destroys this card and only then calls Duel.NegateEffect.

official_references.official_effect_text: If this card is in your hand or GY (Quick Effect): You can Tribute 1 "@Ignister" monster; Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. When a card or effect is activated that targets a Cyberse monster(s) you control, and you control a Cyberse monster that was Special Summoned from the Extra Deck (Quick Effect): You can Tribute this card; negate that effect. You can only use each effect of "Kurikurinku @Ignister" once per turn.

official_references.matched_structure: destroy own card before dependent operation
official_references.official_effect_text: During your Main Phase: You can destroy 1 card you control, and if you do, send 1 Dinosaur monster from your Deck to the GY, then you can Special Summon "Jurrac" monsters from your hand and/or Deck whose total Levels equal the sent monster's Level, except "Jurrac Stego", ignoring their Summoning conditions, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except Dinosaur monsters. You can only use this effect of "Jurrac Stego" once per turn. When this card is destroyed by battle: You can return 1 face-up card on the field to the hand.

effects.printed_clause: This card can attack while in face-up Defense Position. If it does, apply its DEF for damage calculation. If you Special Summoned a "Chrono-Saur" or Dinosaur monster this turn: You can Special Summon this card from your hand or GY in Defense Position. When your opponent activates a card effect that targets a Dinosaur monster you control, or when your opponent targets your Dinosaur monster for an attack (Quick effect): You can destroy this card, then negate that attack or effect. You can only use each effect of "Chrono-Saur Tricera" once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: A field EVENT_BE_BATTLE_TARGET trigger verifies a controlled face-up Dinosaur attack target, destroys this card, then Duel.NegateAttack; the attack/effect branches share id+100 while the Summon uses id.

official_references.official_effect_text: [b]When[/b] an opponent's monster declares an attack: [b]Target[/b] the attacking monster; [b]negate[/b] the attack, [b]then[/b] end the [b]Battle Phase[/b].

If your opponent controls 2 or more monsters, [b]you can[/b] Special Summon this card (from your hand). [b]You can[/b] only Special Summon "Moon Gardna" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b] this way. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned [b]and[/b] your opponent controls a monster: [b]You can[/b] [b]target[/b] 1 Level 4 LIGHT monster in your GY, except "Moon Gardna"; add it to your hand. [b]You can[/b] only use this effect of "Moon Gardna" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b].
